verified_findings.title: 16 sentinel tests named *Sentinel.php (not *Test.php) are NEVER collected by CI — silently disabled guardrails incl. NF525 CompositionSnapshot immutability + both Z-cron sentinels (whose assertions have ALSO drifted stale)
verified_findings.grep_evidence: find tests -name '*Sentinel.php' ! -name '*Test.php' -> 16 files (incl Fiscal/CompositionSnapshotImmutabilityTriggerSentinel.php, Fiscal/ZCloseSafetyNetCronSentinel.php, Fiscal/ZOpenSafetyNetCronSentinel.php, Refund/RefundCashMovementRecordedSentinel.php, Orders/OrderServiceChangeStatusRaceSentinel.php + 11 Security/Deploy/Migration/Database/Stripe). phpunit.xml:12 = <directory suffix="Test.php">./tests/Feature</directory>. CI = vendor/bin/phpunit --testdox (.github/workflows/phpunit.yml:150). EMPIRICAL (macOS, ran without GNU timeout): vendor/bin/phpunit --list-tests collected 2734 tests; grep -iE 'ZCloseSafetyNet|ZOpenSafetyNet|CompositionSnapshotImmutability' -> EXIT 1 (ABSENT), while 'BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest' (ends Test.php) IS present (exit 0). Proof-of-harm dispositive: ZCloseSafetyNetCronSentinel.php:67-71 asserts '55 23 * * *' but Kernel.php:362 schedules dailyAt('23:59') (->'59 23 * * *'); ZOpenSafetyNetCronSentinel.php:73-78 asserts '5 0 * * *' but Kernel.php:407 dailyAt('00:01') (->'1 0 * * *'). A would-RED assertion in a GREEN suite proves these files do not execute — also forecloses any 'a hook/canary runs them' objection (they'd be RED). CompositionSnapshotImmutabilityTriggerSentinel.php:42 extends TestCase with 7 test_ methods guarding NF525 composition_snapshot immutability (CLAUDE.md §8).
verified_findings.recommendation: Two-step, no frozen-zone touch (tests + Kernel.php schedule lines are NOT §7 — only app/Services/Fiscal/* services are frozen, and they are untouched): (a) fix the two stale cron assertions to Path A SSOT — ZCloseSafetyNetCronSentinel.php:68 -> '59 23 * * *', ZOpenSafetyNetCronSentinel.php:74 -> '1 0 * * *'; (b) triage all 16 for similar drift, THEN flip discovery (rename to *SentinelTest.php OR add <directory suffix="Sentinel.php"> testsuite). Flip discovery BEFORE fixing assertions = CI RED. Add a one-line meta-sentinel asserting `find tests -name '*Sentinel.php' ! -name '*Test.php'` is empty to prevent recurrence (none exists today — verified).

verified_findings.title: Z-loop dead-zone comment is internally contradictory: claims '~10s residual window' (23:59:55/00:00:05) while the code and the comment's own closing sentence use dailyAt('23:59')/dailyAt('00:01') = ~2-min window
verified_findings.grep_evidence: Kernel.php:357-360 comment: '...Now 23:59:55 close + 00:00:05 open = ~10s residual window only (orphan risk reduced ~99.97%)...'; but Kernel.php:362 = ->dailyAt('23:59') (Laravel dailyAt is HH:MM only, runs 23:59:00, no seconds), and Kernel.php:404-405 correctly says 'open at 00:01 Paris (was 00:05) ... shrinks ~10 min -> ~2 min residual'. The two halves of the same block disagree (~10s vs ~2min). Real window 23:59:00 -> 00:01:00 = ~2 min, matching commit 860905b78 'compress 10min->2min'. Documentation-only contradiction, zero functional impact.
verified_findings.recommendation: Severity downgraded P2->P3 (stale code comment, no functional effect; adjacent to finding #1, fold under its triage). Fix Kernel.php:357-360 to state the true ~2-min window. No frozen-zone touch. The ~2-min orphan window itself is the designed, owner-deferred behavior (Path B business_date SSOT deferred V1.0.X) backed by fiscal_alloc_error_at + retry cron — not a defect for V1 LOCAL single-resto.

verified_findings.title: Audit-chain retry-on-UNIQUE is ineffective under its own trigger AND wholly untested (test-vs-production gap) — FROZEN ZONE
verified_findings.grep_evidence: performInsert() catches UNIQUE QueryException and recursively re-calls itself at AuditLogService.php:188 (`return $this->performInsert($data, $branchId, $attempt + 1);`) while still inside DB::transaction opened at :112. Retry re-reads tail via lastHashFor() :245-253 = plain `AuditLog::query()->orderBy('id','desc')->value('current_hash')` — NO FOR UPDATE/lock. config/database.php: grep -n 'isolation|READ COMMITTED|REPEATABLE' -> EXIT 1 (no override -> MySQL default REPEATABLE READ): in-transaction re-read returns SAME snapshot tail -> same prev_hash -> identical UNIQUE violation. Net: retry cannot resolve the fork it is designed for on V1 MySQL. COVERAGE: tests/Feature/Fiscal/AuditLogConcurrencyTest.php:82 test_retry_after_forced_collision_produces_consistent_chain writes 3 rows SEQUENTIALLY via service->write() (:85/:93/:96) — each acquires the cache lock so NO collision occurs and the :188 retry branch never executes; it asserts the happy path. test_unique_chain_index_rejects_fork:47 uses raw DB::table()->insert() bypassing performInsert. Retry branch = ZERO coverage.
verified_findings.recommendation: FROZEN ZONE (CLAUDE.md §7 — AuditLogService.php). Do NOT edit without owner LOCK. V1 impact nil: retry only fires when Cache::lock fails to serialize (cache outage / multi-instance split-brain), impossible on V1 LOCAL single-box (the lock alone guarantees no fork). For V1-FINAL: (1) add a regression test that forces a genuine collision (concurrent processes, or a test-double whose first lastHashFor returns a stale tail) so the retry branch is exercised + its true behavior documented; (2) defer the implementation fix (per-attempt transaction OR re-read under lockForUpdate/READ COMMITTED) to a V2/multi-instance LOCK. Latent, NOT a V1 ship gate.

verified_findings.title: Cash-overview summary (by_source/by_mode/total) silently under-counts on >500-transaction days while the reconciliation card stays correct
verified_findings.grep_evidence: CashOverviewController.php:70 const MAX_ROWS = 500; :146 query `->limit(self::MAX_ROWS)`; :202 `$summary = $this->summarize($transactions)` aggregates ONLY the capped collection into total/by_source/by_mode. On a busy day >500 payment tx in the window, the ecart-detection summary reflects only the most-recent 500 rows -> under-stated grand total + per-source buckets. :252 meta.capped flag set true but the summary numbers themselves are silently partial. expected_cash is UNAFFECTED — uses drawerCashCollectedUnfiltered() (:222, separate uncapped sum, Fix C-014 documented :214-221), so the primary drawer ecart number stays correct. Asymmetry confirmed by-design for the drawer column but NOT mirrored for the summary.
verified_findings.recommendation: Non-frozen (ordinary admin controller). V1 Le Cayenne single-resto unlikely to exceed 500 tx in a default window, so latent P3. For V1-FINAL: compute the summary from an uncapped aggregate query (GROUP BY source/mode) independent of the 500-row display cap — mirror the drawerCashCollectedUnfiltered pattern. Add a test seeding >500 transactions to assert the summary total matches the uncapped sum. No existing test seeds >500, so the under-count is invisible to the suite (tests/Feature/Admin/CashOverviewControllerTest.php + tests/e2e/wave-x4-cash-overview.spec.js).
